scientific_intent.application_domain: Exciton / quantum molecular dynamics commutator primitive
scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Complex matrix commutator -i[H,sigma] times source HDT for a batch of 7x7 matrices
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Direct dense commutator with source arithmetic/layout variants; independent Float64 complex fsum, diagonal-H analytic and trace identities, source/input-derived identity FMA residual set
scientific_intent.community_use: Commutator stage relevant to quantum density-matrix evolution; this isolated primitive is not an integrated physical dynamics simulation.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Full pointwise atol1e-6+rtol1e-4 to actual-input Float64 oracle; revised-secondary exact identity residual set {0,±r}; full input bits and canaries exact.
limitations: Source default H is real nonsymmetric, so measured algebra is not Hermitian Hamiltonian physics, density positivity or evolution fidelity.
H imaginary entries zero: native IDs2/3 ignored macro argument for imaginary-H is unmeasured, not arbitrary complex-H certification.
Full source packages N256/512 and DIM7 only; no partial tails or original NUM2048 CLI certification.
One of25 entries is an empty execution-only baseline with no numerical outputs.
Post-observation checker revision is separate excluded untouched-native stratum; original rejected strict-zero native capture preserved.
